summary: This release brings 2x faster performance, new dark mode shaders, and critical bug fixes.
newFeatures: Added high-performance GPU acceleration for 4K workflows
New customizable export pipeline with WebP & AVIF presets
Integrated Windows 11 Fluent mica window frame styling
improvements: Reduced startup loading time by 58% across all devices
Optimized memory usage during intensive background exports
Smoother high-DPI display scaling on multi-monitor setups
fixes: Fixed crash when opening files containing special Unicode characters
Resolved occasional flickering during window resizing
Fixed shortcut key conflicts on Windows keyboards
